title: Aerial Reconnaissance
subtitle: Drone-Based Target and Route Investigation
description: Conduct an aerial reconnaissance mission over the previously selected observation target. Use the existing drone to inspect the target approach route, capture aerial evidence, and prepare observations for the ground investigation on Sol 6.

persistentMissionData.selectionRule: Use only the target selected and submitted by the player during Sol 3. Do not allow a new target selection during Sol 5.

objectives.title: Complete Drone Mission Briefing
objectives.description: Visit the Mission Control main console and review the Sol 5 aerial reconnaissance objectives, selected target, operational boundaries, and flight restrictions.
objectives.completionCondition: The player reviews and confirms the Sol 5 mission briefing.

objectives.title: Inspect Drone Readiness
objectives.description: Optionally visit the Drone Section and physically inspect the existing drone to review its available operational status information.
objectives.completionCondition: The player interacts with the existing drone inspection interaction and reviews the available status information.

objectives.title: Activate Aerial Reconnaissance
objectives.description: Return to Mission Control and activate the drone simulation through the existing OS Navigation interface.
objectives.completionCondition: The existing drone simulation is successfully initialized and the player enters drone first-person control mode.

objectives.title: Survey the Selected Target
objectives.description: Fly the existing drone toward the Sol 3 selected target and investigate its surrounding terrain and approach route.
objectives.completionCondition: The player conducts the required aerial reconnaissance within the operational flight boundaries.

objectives.title: Capture Aerial Evidence
objectives.description: Capture at least five aerial images from meaningful positions along the selected target approach route.
objectives.completionCondition: At least five valid aerial image records are captured and stored.

objectives.title: Return and Land the Drone
objectives.description: Navigate the drone back to the original take-off point and complete a validated landing.
objectives.completionCondition: The drone reaches the verified take-off point, satisfies landing conditions, and enters the landed state.

objectives.title: Review Aerial Images
objectives.description: Return to the normal player first-person view and review the captured aerial evidence through the existing Mission Control OS.
objectives.completionCondition: The player reviews the captured image records and their associated metadata.

objectives.title: Submit Aerial Reconnaissance Report
objectives.description: Prepare and submit the Sol 5 report using the captured evidence and verified mission records.
objectives.completionCondition: The report passes the mission validation rules and is successfully submitted.

destinations.label: Mission Control Main Console
destinations.purpose: Review the mission briefing and activate the drone simulation.

destinations.label: Airlock Access
destinations.purpose: Access the existing outdoor operational area.

destinations.label: Mission Control Report Station
destinations.purpose: Review aerial evidence and submit the mission report.

restrictions: Do not expose internal physical screen names in player-facing navigation.
Do not expose trigger IDs or implementation identifiers in player-facing navigation.
Do not mark an objective complete merely because the player reaches a destination.
